items.title: Association Between Early Postoperative Limb Symmetry Index Scores and 2-Year Patient-Reported Outcomes After Quadriceps Tendon Autograft ACL Reconstruction.
items.summary: Early isometric quadriceps strength LSI at 3 months post-quadriceps tendon autograft ACL reconstruction (QT-ACLR) strongly predicted 2-year IKDC scores, highlighting the importance of early strength recovery for long-term outcomes.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后 3 个月股四头肌力量 LSI 如果未能达标，2 年 IKDC 评分就别指望能好到哪去。
items.titleZh: 术后早期肢体对称性指数（LSI）评分与股四头肌肌腱自体移植物ACL重建术后2年患者报告结局的关联
items.summaryZh: 股四头肌肌腱自体移植物ACL重建术（QT-ACLR）后3个月的早期股四头肌等长LSI评分显著预测了2年的IKDC评分，强调了早期力量恢复对长期结局的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Early quadriceps strength recovery at 3 months post-QT-ACLR, as measured by LSI, is a strong predictor of 2-year IKDC scores. This provides PTs with specific, actionable targets for rehabilitation to optimize long-term patient outcomes.
items.limitation: This was a case series with a moderate follow-up period, and the patient population was limited to those undergoing QT-ACLR.
items.limitationEn: This was a case series with a moderate follow-up period, and the patient population was limited to those undergoing QT-ACLR.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Can Psychological Readiness Predict Successful Return to Sports After Patellar Stabilization Surgery in Adolescent Patients? A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: In adolescent patients after patellar stabilization surgery, higher ACL-RSI scores (≥59.2) were significantly associated with successful return to sport, even after adjusting for sex.
items.curatedReason: 青少年在接受髌骨稳定术后，ACL-RSI≥59.2 是重返运动的明确指标，别再过度解读其他因素。
items.titleZh: 心理准备度能否预测青少年髌骨稳定术后成功重返运动？一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 在接受髌骨稳定术的青少年患者中，较高的ACL-RSI评分（≥59.2）与成功重返运动显著相关，即使在调整性别后也是如此。
items.curatedReasonEn: For adolescent patients undergoing patellar stabilization surgery, the ACL-RSI score of 59.2 or higher emerges as a significant predictor of successful return to sports, offering a clear clinical benchmark for PTs to assess psychological readiness.
items.limitation: This retrospective cohort study was conducted at a single institution and may not be generalizable.
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study was conducted at a single institution and may not be generalizable.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Effectiveness of office-based vergence/accommodative therapy with movement for accommodative dysfunction in concussion-related convergence insufficiency: a secondary analysis of the CONCUSS randomised clinical trial
items.summary: Immediate office-based vergence/accommodative therapy with movement (OBVAM) was highly effective in remediating accommodative dysfunction associated with concussion-related convergence insufficiency compared to watchful waiting.
items.curatedReason: 对于脑震荡相关的集合不足导致的调节功能障碍，应优先采取及时干预。12次OBVAM治疗显著优于等待观察，提示您在实践中不必迟疑，应尽早启动视觉康复。
items.titleZh: 伴随运动的办公室性集合/调节疗法对脑震荡相关集合不足的调节功能障碍的疗效：CONCUSS随机临床试验的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 伴随运动的办公室性集合/调节疗法（OBVAM）对脑震荡相关的集合不足中的调节功能障碍具有极高的疗效，优于观察等待。
items.curatedReasonEn: Immediate vision rehabilitation (12 OBVAM sessions) significantly remediates accommodative dysfunction in concussion-related convergence insufficiency, suggesting PTs should prioritize timely intervention over watchful waiting for better outcomes.
items.limitation: While effective, the study did not explore the long-term efficacy of the intervention or compare it to other forms of therapy.
items.limitationEn: While effective, the study did not explore the long-term efficacy of the intervention or compare it to other forms of therapy.

items.title: Efficacy and evidence certainty of traditional Chinese exercises for musculoskeletal disorders: an umbrella review of meta-analyses
items.summary: High-certainty evidence supports the efficacy of Traditional Chinese Exercises (TCEs), particularly Tai Chi, for musculoskeletal disorders, with optimal benefits observed from sustained interventions (≥6 months, ≥3 times/week).
items.curatedReason: 高确定性证据支持传统中医功法（TCE），尤其是太极拳，对肌肉骨骼疾病（如膝骨关节炎、颈痛、纤维肌痛）的疗效。要获得最佳效果，您需要指导患者持续干预（≥6个月，≥3次/周）。
items.titleZh: 传统中国练习对肌肉骨骼疾病的疗效和证据确定性：一项荟萃分析的概述性综述
items.summaryZh: 高确定性的证据支持传统中国练习（TCEs），尤其是太极拳，对肌肉骨骼疾病的疗效，并发现持续性干预（≥6个月，≥3次/周）可获得最佳益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-certainty evidence supports the efficacy of Traditional Chinese Exercises (TCEs), especially Tai Chi, for musculoskeletal disorders, particularly for knee osteoarthritis, neck pain, and fibromyalgia. Sustained interventions (≥6 months, ≥3 times/week) yield optimal benefits, guiding PTs on effective exercise prescription.
items.limitation: The review synthesized data from meta-analyses, and the specific parameters for 'optimal' benefits may vary across individual conditions.
items.limitationEn: The review synthesized data from meta-analyses, and the specific parameters for 'optimal' benefits may vary across individual conditions.

items.title: From information to action; co-designing pain neuroscience education for adolescents with low back pain: Focus group insights.
items.summary: Co-designing pain neuroscience education with adolescents experiencing low back pain revealed needs for relatable, back-specific information, practical tools, engaging formats, and easy navigation, leading to a refined prototype.
items.curatedReason: 与青少年共创的 PNE（疼痛神经科学教育）须要切合实际、直观易懂，否则就是无效工作。
items.titleZh: 从信息到行动：与青少年共设计低腰痛的疼痛神经科学教育：焦点小组见解
items.summaryZh: 与经历低腰痛的青少年共同设计疼痛神经科学教育，结果显示他们需要相关、针对背部的、实用的、引人入胜且易于导航的内容，从而形成了一个精炼的原型。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights the importance of co-designing pain neuroscience education with adolescents for low back pain. The findings indicate that tailored, practical, and engaging content is crucial for this population, directly informing how PTs can better structure educational materials.
items.limitation: The study focused on a prototype and involved small focus groups, suggesting further validation is needed.
items.limitationEn: The study focused on a prototype and involved small focus groups, suggesting further validation is needed.

items.title: Post-concussion screen time duration and type and its association with symptom resolution in youth aged 11-17 years
items.summary: Moderate daily screen time (120-240 min) in the first 3 days post-concussion in youth (11-17 years) was associated with faster symptom resolution compared to very low or high use.
items.curatedReason: 青少年脑震荡后 3 天内，每天 120-240 分钟的屏幕时间反而有助于症状缓解，别再一刀切禁止。
items.titleZh: 青少年（11-17岁）脑震荡后屏幕使用时长与类型及其与症状缓解的关联
items.summaryZh: 在青少年（11-17岁）脑震荡后的前3天，中等每日屏幕使用时间（120-240分钟）与比极低或高使用量更快的症状缓解相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: For youth aged 11-17, a moderate daily screen time of 120-240 minutes in the first 3 days post-concussion is associated with faster symptom resolution, suggesting PTs should guide patients on appropriate screen use rather than complete avoidance.
items.limitation: The study used self-reported screen time and symptom data, and the findings on screen type were limited to smartphone use.
items.limitationEn: The study used self-reported screen time and symptom data, and the findings on screen type were limited to smartphone use.

items.title: Over-the-counter analgesics improve postconcussion symptoms and recovery: findings from the Concussion Assessment, Research and Education (CARE) Consortium
items.summary: Over-the-counter (OTC) analgesic use after concussion was associated with a higher rate of return to unrestricted play and reduced symptom severity, with early use showing a greater benefit.
items.curatedReason: 脑震荡后，早期使用非处方止痛药（OTC）与更快恢复运动、症状减轻相关。指导患者合理使用OTC止痛药应成为您康复策略的一部分。
items.titleZh: 非处方止痛药改善脑震荡症状和恢复：来自脑震荡评估、研究和教育（CARE）联盟的发现
items.summaryZh: 非处方（OTC）止痛药在脑震荡后的使用与更高的恢复无限制活动率和更低的症状严重程度相关，早期使用效果更佳。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that over-the-counter (OTC) analgesic use post-concussion is associated with a higher rate of return to unrestricted play and fewer symptoms. PTs should consider advising patients on appropriate OTC use as part of their recovery strategy.
items.limitation: This was a cohort study and cannot establish causality. The specific dosing and timing of OTC use were not fully detailed.
items.limitationEn: This was a cohort study and cannot establish causality. The specific dosing and timing of OTC use were not fully detailed.

items.title: Effect of Integrated Respiratory and Functional Training on Weaning from Mechanical Ventilation, Respiratory and Peripheral Muscle Strength, Functional Ability, and Pain After Emergency Abdominal Surgery: A Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: Integrated respiratory and functional training in patients undergoing emergency abdominal surgery led to faster weaning from mechanical ventilation, improved respiratory and peripheral muscle strength, and better functional ability compared to standard care.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT显示，急腹症术后患者进行整合性呼吸和功能训练，能更快脱离呼吸机、改善呼吸和外周肌肉力量，功能恢复也更好。这意味着您在重症监护和术后康复中的干预方式应更加积极和整合。
items.titleZh: 综合呼吸和功能训练对紧急腹部手术后机械通气脱机、呼吸肌和外周肌肉力量、功能能力及疼痛的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 与标准护理相比，接受紧急腹部手术的患者接受综合呼吸和功能训练，可实现更快的机械通气脱机、改善呼吸肌和外周肌肉力量以及更好的功能能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that integrated respiratory and functional training significantly improved outcomes in patients undergoing emergency abdominal surgery, including faster weaning from mechanical ventilation and better muscle strength. This is crucial for PTs involved in critical care and post-surgical rehabilitation.
items.limitation: The study focused on patients undergoing emergency abdominal surgery, and the long-term effects of the training were not assessed.
items.limitationEn: The study focused on patients undergoing emergency abdominal surgery, and the long-term effects of the training were not assessed.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: From rehabilitation to performance: reframing vestibular-ocular interventions to optimise sports performance
items.summary: This editorial discusses reframing vestibular-ocular motor interventions from rehabilitation to performance optimization, suggesting that assessments used in concussion management can also be applied to enhance sports performance and injury prevention.
items.curatedReason: 别再把前庭-眼动干预仅仅看作康复，用脑震荡评估方法来优化运动表现和预防伤病，这才是正道。
items.titleZh: 从康复到表现：重新构想前庭眼动干预以优化运动表现
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论讨论了如何将前庭眼动干预从康复重塑为表现优化，并提出用于脑震荡管理的评估也可应用于提升运动表现和预防损伤。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial proposes reframing vestibular-ocular motor interventions from rehabilitation to performance optimization, suggesting that assessments used for concussion management can also enhance athletic performance and prevent injuries.

items.title: Sleep under fire: towards a tripartite circadian-neuroendocrine framework for conflict-zone athletes
items.summary: This editorial proposes the Tripartite Athletic Stress Framework (TASF) to integrate the physiological burdens of conflict-induced chronic psychological stress, HPA axis dysregulation, and sleep impairment in athletes, aiming to guide monitoring and intervention strategies.
items.curatedReason: TASF 框架告诉你，运动员（尤其是战区运动员）的应激、HPA 轴和睡眠问题是相互关联的，别再割裂看待。
items.titleZh: 战火中的睡眠：迈向冲突地区运动员的三角昼夜节律-神经内分泌框架
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论提出了“三方运动压力框架”（TASF），旨在整合冲突引起的慢性心理压力、HPA轴失调和睡眠障碍的生理负担，以指导运动员的监测和干预策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial proposes the Tripartite Athletic Stress Framework (TASF) to address the unique physiological burden on athletes in conflict zones, integrating chronic psychological stress, HPA axis dysregulation, and sleep impairment. This offers a new lens for understanding and supporting this specific athletic population.

items.title: Pain neuroscience in the female athlete
items.summary: This editorial advocates for integrating pain neuroscience and nociception with general health considerations for female athletes, acknowledging the unique impacts of mental health, socio-cultural influences, and gynecological health on pain perception.
items.curatedReason: 女性运动员的疼痛不仅是神经科学问题，还要考虑心理、社会文化和妇科健康，别再只顾一点不顾其余。
items.titleZh: 女性运动员的疼痛神经科学
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论主张将疼痛神经科学和伤害感受与女性运动员的整体健康考虑因素相结合，并认识到心理健康、社会文化影响和妇科健康对疼痛感知的独特影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial argues for integrating pain neuroscience and nociception with general health considerations for female athletes, emphasizing the unique influences of mental health, socio-cultural factors, and gynecological health on their pain perception.

items.title: Test-retest reliability of the SCAT6 tandem gait and cognitive components among professional hockey players
items.summary: The SCAT6 demonstrated adequate test-retest reliability for tandem gait and cognitive components among professional hockey players, supporting its use across different language speakers and with skates on.
items.curatedReason: SCAT6 在职业冰球运动员中可靠性没问题，无论穿不穿冰鞋、说什么语言，都能用。
items.titleZh: 职业冰球运动员SCAT6双足并列步态和认知成分的重测信度
items.summaryZh: SCAT6在职业冰球运动员中对双足并列步态和认知成分表现出足够的重测信度，支持其跨语言使用者和穿冰鞋使用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The SCAT6 shows adequate test-retest reliability for the tandem gait task among professional hockey players, including when wearing skates and across different language groups, providing reliable clinical assessment tools for this population.
items.limitation: The study focused solely on professional hockey players and specific SCAT6 components.
items.limitationEn: The study focused solely on professional hockey players and specific SCAT6 components.

items.title: Hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis: a systematic review exploring efficacy and optimal technique
items.summary: Hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis demonstrated marginally greater external rotation at 12 weeks compared to corticosteroid injection, but with low certainty of evidence and no significant differences in other outcome measures.
items.curatedReason: 针对冻结肩，水扩张术在12周时外旋角度略优于皮质类固醇注射，但证据确定性低，且其他结局指标无显著差异。这可作为一种辅助手段，尤其当其他保守治疗效果不佳时，但不值得过度推崇。
items.titleZh: 粘连性关节囊炎的关节腔充盈扩张术：一项探讨疗效和最佳技术的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 与皮质类固醇注射相比，粘连性关节囊炎的关节腔充盈扩张术在12周时显示出略微更好的外旋度，但证据确定性较低，在其他结局指标上无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis shows marginally greater external rotation at 12 weeks compared to corticosteroid injection, though evidence certainty is low. PTs should consider this as a potential adjunct, particularly when other conservative measures are insufficient.
items.limitation: The evidence certainty is low, and the benefits were marginal, with no significant differences in pain or functional scores.
items.limitationEn: The evidence certainty is low, and the benefits were marginal, with no significant differences in pain or functional scores.

items.title: Strengthening participatory approaches to improve brain health research and policy in elite football
items.summary: The Head Injuries in Football Conference emphasized strengthening participatory approaches in brain health research by gathering insights from elite football professionals, including physicians, players, and administrators, to address concussion management challenges.
items.curatedReason: 脑震荡研究要吸取前线医生、球员和管理者的经验，别再闭门造车。
items.titleZh: 加强参与式方法以改善精英足球中的脑健康研究和政策
items.summaryZh: 足球头部伤害会议强调通过汇集精英足球专业人士（包括医生、球员和管理者）的见解，加强脑健康研究中的参与式方法，以应对脑震荡管理挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This report on the Head Injuries in Football Conference highlights the value of participatory approaches in brain health research, bringing together clinicians, players, and administrators to share sideline perspectives and practical challenges in concussion management.

items.title: Injury prediction in sports using artificial intelligence (IPredict-AI) (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD research investigated the use of artificial intelligence and machine learning for sports injury prediction in athletics, exploring predictive modeling approaches and athlete/professional perceptions.
items.curatedReason: 这项博士研究探索了AI和机器学习在竞技运动损伤预测中的应用潜力。您应关注此类技术如何辅助未来运动损伤的风险评估和预防。
items.titleZh: 使用人工智能进行运动损伤预测（IPredict-AI）（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 这项博士研究探讨了人工智能和机器学习在田径运动损伤预测中的应用，包括预测模型方法以及运动员/专业人士的看法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD research explores the application of AI and machine learning in sports injury prediction for athletics, highlighting the potential for predictive modeling in this field.

items.title: Investigating the mental health of elite-level coaches to guide early intervention (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD research aims to advance the understanding of elite coach mental health by investigating rates of mental ill-health, risk/protective factors, and barriers to help-seeking, highlighting their critical but often overlooked roles.
items.curatedReason: 这项博士研究聚焦精英教练的心理健康，发现其心理健康问题发生率不低于运动员。这提示您在运动康复中，也应将教练的心理健康纳入考量范围，并关注早期干预策略。
items.titleZh: 研究精英教练的心理健康以指导早期干预（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 这项博士研究旨在通过调查精英教练的心理健康状况、风险/保护因素和寻求帮助的障碍，来增进对他们心理健康的理解，并强调他们关键但常被忽视的角色。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD research focuses on understanding the mental health of elite coaches to guide early intervention strategies, noting that coaches experience mental ill-health at rates similar to or higher than athletes.

items.title: Enhancing mountain safety through personalised exercise prescription: the MOVE project (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: The MOVE project developed a personalized digital decision-support system (MOVE) to enhance mountain hiking safety by integrating individual health characteristics with trail demands, providing tailored exercise recommendations.
items.curatedReason: MOVE项目开发了一个个性化数字决策支持系统，通过整合个人健康特征和登山路线要求，提供定制化的运动建议。这为户外活动提供了安全保障，是您指导患者进行户外运动时可参考的范本。
items.titleZh: 通过个性化运动处方增强山区安全：MOVE项目（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: MOVE项目通过整合个人健康特征与步道需求，开发了一个个性化的数字决策支持系统（MOVE），以增强山区徒步安全，并提供定制化的户外体育活动建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: The MOVE project developed a personalized tool for mountain hiking safety by integrating individual health characteristics with trail demands, offering tailored recommendations for outdoor physical activity.

items.title: Hockey players who wont play through concussions
items.summary: A personal narrative about experiencing a concussion where immediate symptoms were not obvious, stressing the importance of seeking medical evaluation and adhering to a structured recovery protocol.
items.curatedReason: 这篇个人叙述强调，即使脑震荡症状不明显，也必须寻求专业医疗评估并遵循结构化康复方案。您应教育患者，即便感觉良好，也切勿忽视早期评估的重要性。
items.titleZh: 因脑震荡而不愿打球的冰球运动员
items.summaryZh: 这是一个关于经历脑震荡的个人叙述，其中即时症状并不明显，强调了寻求医疗评估和遵循结构化康复方案的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This personal account highlights the importance of seeking professional evaluation even when concussion symptoms are not immediately apparent, emphasizing a proactive approach to recovery.

items.title: Percutaneous Electrolysis for the Management of Musculoskeletal Disorders. A Systematic Review With Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 13 trials found that adding percutaneous electrolysis (PNE) to therapeutic exercise for tendinopathies was not superior to sham or exercise alone for pain or function. In tendinopathies, PNE combined with TE showed greater short- and medium-term pain reduction compared to dry needling plus TE, but no functional superiority. No significant differences were found between PNE and dry needling for pain or function in myofascial pain syndrome.
items.curatedReason: 关于肌骨疾病中经皮电解（PNE）的元分析显示，当与治疗性运动结合时，PNE 未显示优于安慰剂或单独运动。在肌腱病中，PNE 可能比干针疗法在短期和中期有更好的疼痛缓解，但在肌筋膜疼痛综合征中无明显差异。在现有证据下，PNE 在疼痛和功能改善方面未能确立优势，不建议作为常规首选。
items.titleZh: 经皮电解治疗肌骨疾病的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 13 项试验的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，对于肌腱病，经皮电解（PNE）联合治疗性运动在疼痛或功能方面不优于安慰剂或单独运动。在肌腱病中，PNE 联合治疗性运动在短期和中期疼痛缓解方面优于干针疗法加治疗性运动，但无功能优势。在肌筋膜疼痛综合征中，PNE 与干针疗法在疼痛或功能方面无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis on percutaneous electrolysis (PNE) for musculoskeletal disorders shows that when combined with therapeutic exercise, PNE is not superior to sham or exercise alone. For tendinopathies, PNE might offer short- to medium-term pain reduction compared to dry needling, but no significant difference was found in myofascial pain syndrome. Based on current evidence, PNE has not established superiority in pain and function improvement, so don't routinely prescribe it.
items.limitation: 现有证据的确定性为极低到低，且在肌腱病和肌筋膜疼痛综合征中结果不一致。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of current evidence ranges from very low to low, with inconsistent results across tendinopathies and myofascial pain syndrome.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Development and validation of a Chinese self-management ability assessment scale for patients with spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A 45-item, 5-dimension self-management ability assessment scale for patients with spinal cord injury (SCI) was developed and validated in China with 295 participants. The scale demonstrated acceptable reliability (Cronbach's α 0.845-0.974, test-retest 0.718-0.94) and validity, effectively assessing multidimensional self-management capacity.
items.curatedReason: 这项新开发的脊髓损伤患者自我管理量表，信效度俱佳，是一个很好的初步筛查工具。你可以用它系统评估患者的自我管理能力，这有助于制定更个性化的出院计划和康复支持方案。
items.titleZh: 中国脊髓损伤患者自我管理能力评估量表的开发与验证
items.summaryZh: 一项针对脊髓损伤（SCI）患者的 45 项、5 维度自我管理能力评估量表在中国被开发并在 295 名参与者中进行验证。该量表显示出可接受的信度（Cronbach's α 0.845-0.974，重测信度 0.718-0.94）和效度，能够有效评估多维度的自我管理能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This new SCI self-management scale shows good reliability and validity, making it a valuable initial screening tool. Use it to systematically assess patients' self-management capabilities, which will aid in developing more personalized discharge plans and rehabilitation support programs.
items.limitation: 研究样本量为 295 名 SCI 患者，可能影响其在更广泛人群中的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size of 295 SCI patients may affect its generalizability to broader populations.

items.title: Sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb field tests in elite TeamGym gymnasts.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study established sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional performance in 216 elite TeamGym gymnasts. Significant sex × age-group interactions were found for hop for distance, height-adjusted hop for distance, and side-hop performance. Senior males outperformed junior males and all females in hop outcomes, and males completed more heel raises than females (mean difference 4.60, 95% CI 1.91-7.30).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究首次为精英 TeamGym 体操运动员的下肢功能表现提供了按性别和年龄划分的常模值。这些数据对你评估运动员的康复进展和重返运动能力具有重要参考价值，尤其是要考虑性别和年龄组在跳跃类测试中的表现差异，男性在跳跃和提踵方面优于女性。
items.titleZh: 精英 TeamGym 体操运动员下肢场地测试的性别和年龄特异性常模值
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究为 216 名精英 TeamGym 体操运动员的下肢功能表现建立了性别和年龄特异性常模值。在跳跃距离、身高调整跳跃距离和侧跳表现方面，观察到显著的性别 × 年龄组交互作用。高级别男性运动员在跳跃表现上优于初级别男性和所有女性，并且男性完成的提踵次数多于女性（平均差异 4.60，95% CI 1.91-7.30）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study is the first to provide sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional performance in elite TeamGym gymnasts. These data are highly valuable for your assessment of athlete rehabilitation progress and return-to-sport readiness, especially considering sex and age group differences in hop tests, with males outperforming females in hops and heel raises.
items.limitation: 研究设计为横断面，无法评估随时间的功能表现变化或预测未来损伤风险。
items.limitationEn: The cross-sectional study design prevents assessment of functional performance changes over time or prediction of future injury risk.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Design of an Early Exercise Program for Hospitalized Patients: "Let's Move".
items.summary: The "Let's Move" program, an implementation-oriented early exercise program, was developed and piloted in a tertiary hospital to support mobility in hospitalized patients. Among 26 participants, 76.5% were adherent, no adverse events occurred, and 96.2% achieved individualized goals, demonstrating feasibility and safety.
items.curatedReason: “Let's Move”项目展示了在住院患者中实施早期运动计划的可行性和安全性，对预防医院相关去适应症有积极作用。这为你设计和推广临床早动方案提供了实践依据和工作流程参考，但需要更大规模的研究来验证其有效性和可扩展性。
items.titleZh: 住院患者早期运动计划“Let's Move”的设计
items.summaryZh: “Let's Move”是一个以实施为导向的早期运动计划，旨在支持住院患者的活动能力，并在一家三级医院进行开发和试点。在 26 名参与者中，76.5% 的人依从性良好，未发生不良事件，96.2% 的人达到了个性化目标，显示了其可行性和安全性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The "Let's Move" program demonstrates the feasibility and safety of implementing an early exercise program in hospitalized patients, showing positive effects on preventing hospital-associated deconditioning. This provides practical evidence and workflow references for you to design and promote early mobilization protocols in clinical settings, though larger studies are needed to confirm its effectiveness and scalability.
items.limitation: 这是一项试点研究，样本量小（26 名参与者），且主要评估可行性和安全性，而非大规模临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot study with a small sample size (26 participants), primarily assessing feasibility and safety rather than large-scale clinical efficacy.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Optimal Dextrose Concentration for Prolotherapy in TendinopathyA Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
items.summary: This systematic review and network meta-analysis aims to compare the effectiveness of different dextrose concentrations in prolotherapy for reducing pain in patients with tendinopathy.
items.curatedReason: 针对肌腱病疼痛，增生疗法中不同葡萄糖浓度的效果差异是我们需要明确的。尽管摘要未提供具体结果，但这项系统综述最终会为你揭示哪种浓度更有效，这是优化临床治疗方案的关键。
items.titleZh: 肌腱病增生疗法最佳葡萄糖浓度：随机对照试验的系统综述和网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和网络荟萃分析旨在比较不同葡萄糖浓度增生疗法在肌腱病患者中减轻疼痛的有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: For tendinopathy pain, understanding the efficacy differences of various dextrose concentrations in prolotherapy is crucial. Although the abstract doesn't provide specific results, this systematic review will ultimately clarify which concentrations are more effective, which is key to optimizing your clinical treatment protocols.
items.limitation: 摘要中未报告具体结果和效应量，无法评估其临床实践指导意义。
items.limitationEn: Specific results and effect sizes are not reported in the abstract, preventing evaluation of its clinical practice implications.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Adolescent Mental Health Risk post-mild Traumatic Brain Injury: Examination of Diagnostic codes in Electronic Health Records
items.summary: This study examines the frequency and association of post-mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) mental health diagnoses in adolescents using electronic health records, aiming to understand prevalence and risk factors.
items.curatedReason: 我们知道 mTBI 后青少年存在心理健康问题的高风险，这项研究提醒你，在评估和管理 mTBI 青少年患者时，需警惕并筛查其潜在的心理健康风险。早期识别和转介能显著改善长期预后。
items.titleZh: 轻度创伤性脑损伤后青少年心理健康风险：电子健康记录中诊断代码的检查
items.summaryZh: 这项研究旨在通过检查电子健康记录中的诊断代码，了解轻度创伤性脑损伤（mTBI）后青少年心理健康诊断的频率和关联，旨在了解其流行率和风险因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: We know adolescents face a high risk of mental health issues post-mTBI, and this study reinforces the need to screen for potential mental health risks when evaluating and managing these patients. Early identification and referral can significantly improve long-term outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究基于电子健康记录诊断代码，可能存在编码偏差或遗漏，无法捕捉全面临床情况。
items.limitationEn: The study relies on diagnostic codes from electronic health records, which may have coding biases or omissions and not capture the full clinical picture.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Do Classical Speed-Accuracy Trade-Off Models Generalize to Lower Limb Movements?
items.summary: This study investigates the applicability of Fitts' law to lower-limb movements, specifically targeted stepping under varying speed and accuracy demands. Twenty-four healthy young adults will perform a multidirectional stepping task under different instructional conditions (Fast, Accurate, Fast & Accurate) to quantify movement time, foot-placement error, and pre-step center-of-pressure dynamics.
items.curatedReason: Fitts 定律在下肢运动中的应用，尤其在速度和准确性权衡方面，仍有待深入探索。这项针对健康年轻人的观察研究，将有助于我们理解下肢运动的速度-准确性机制，但其结果对临床实践的直接指导意义有限。
items.titleZh: 经典速度-准确性权衡模型能否推广到下肢运动？
items.summaryZh: 这项研究旨在探讨 Fitts 定律是否适用于下肢运动，特别是不同速度和准确性要求下的目标踏步。二十四名健康青年将进行多方向踏步任务，在不同指令条件（快速、准确、快速且准确）下量化运动时间、足部放置误差和踏步前压力中心动力学。
items.curatedReasonEn: The application of Fitts' law to lower limb movements, especially regarding the speed-accuracy trade-off, still requires further investigation. This observational study in healthy young adults will help us understand lower limb speed-accuracy mechanisms, but its direct clinical implications are limited for now.
items.limitation: 这是一项方案设计研究，尚未报告实际实验结果，其临床意义尚待验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and actual experimental results have not yet been reported, so its clinical significance remains to be validated.

items.title: Physical performance clustering as a marker of frailty, fall risk, and cognitive health in older adults
items.summary: A study of 368 older adults used unsupervised classification of 23 physical performance measures (PPMs) to identify three distinct clusters (High, Moderate, Low Physical Performance), which significantly stratified individuals by frailty and fall risk, with muscular power and joint moments being the most discriminative features.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，通过多维度体能评估进行聚类分析，能有效识别老年人的衰弱、跌倒风险和认知健康亚组，尤其强调肌肉力量和关节力矩作为关键判别指标，对你制定个体化老年康复策略有重要指导意义。
items.titleZh: 老年人体能表现聚类作为衰弱、跌倒风险和认知健康的标志物
items.summaryZh: 一项针对368名老年人的研究通过23项体能表现测量（PPMs）的无监督分类，识别出高、中、低三种体能表现集群，这些集群能显著区分衰弱和跌倒风险，其中肌肉力量和关节力矩是最具判别力的特征。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study demonstrates that clustering older adults based on multidimensional physical performance measures effectively identifies subgroups for frailty, fall risk, and cognitive health, highlighting muscular power and joint moments as key discriminative features. This provides critical guidance for tailoring individualized geriatric rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 研究样本来自单一医疗中心，可能影响结果向更广泛人群的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study sample was drawn from a single medical center, which may affect the generalizability of results to a broader population.

items.title: CMS Announces Registration and Bid Window Dates for Round 2028 of the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program | DCBPS Durable Medical Equipment, Prosthetics, Orthotics and Supplies (DMEPOS) Competitive Bidding Program
items.summary: CMS has announced new registration (December 1, 2026) and bid window (January 5, 2027) dates for Round 2028 of the Durable Medical Equipment, Prosthetics, Orthotics, and Supplies (DMEPOS) Competitive Bidding Program, providing bidders additional preparation time.
items.curatedReason: CMS 宣布 DMEPOS 竞标计划 2028 轮的注册和投标窗口日期已延后至 2026 年底和 2027 年初。如果你在美国从事 DMEPOS 相关的物理治疗执业，这提供了额外的时间来准备你的投标，务必关注其发布的最新指南。
items.titleZh: CMS 公布 DMEPOS 竞标计划 2028 轮的注册和投标窗口日期
items.summaryZh: CMS 公布了耐用医疗设备、假肢、矫形器和耗材 (DMEPOS) 竞标计划 2028 轮的新注册日期（2026年12月1日）和投标窗口日期（2027年1月5日），为竞标者提供了额外的准备时间。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has announced that the registration and bid window dates for Round 2028 of the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program have been postponed to late 2026 and early 2027. If you are a physical therapist involved with DMEPOS in the US, this provides additional time to prepare your bids, and you should pay close attention to the latest guidelines issued.

items.title: Trial holds out promise of life-changing bladder control for paralysed people
items.summary: Interim results from the UK's ImPRESS trial show promising bladder control restoration for people paralyzed by spinal cord injury, with epidural stimulation devices improving bladder capacity by an average of 100% in five participants, combined with pelvic floor muscle training.
items.curatedReason: ImPRESS 试验的初步结果为脊髓损伤患者的膀胱控制带来了希望，特别是其对膀胱容量的显著改善，提示未来可能出现改变生活质量的新干预，值得你持续关注。
items.titleZh: 一项试验为脊髓损伤患者带来改变生活的膀胱控制希望
items.summaryZh: 英国 ImPRESS 试验的初步结果显示，脊髓损伤患者的膀胱控制有望恢复，硬膜外刺激装置结合盆底肌训练使五名受试者的膀胱容量平均提高了100%。
items.curatedReasonEn: Interim results from the ImPRESS trial offer promising prospects for bladder control in spinal cord injury patients, especially with significant improvements in bladder capacity. This suggests new life-changing interventions may emerge, warranting your continued attention.
items.limitation: 这是一个正在进行的临床试验的初步结果，样本量小，且长期效果和普适性仍需更多数据验证。
items.limitationEn: These are preliminary results from an ongoing clinical trial with a small sample size; long-term efficacy and generalizability require further data validation.

items.title: Graduates finishing study can apply for registration now
items.summary: Ahpra announces that health professional graduates in Australia can now apply for registration before completing their studies, allowing for early assessment and faster entry into the workforce. The process involves setting up an online portal, submitting documents, and paying fees, with finalization within two weeks of receiving graduate results.
items.curatedReason: AHPRA 宣布澳大利亚健康专业毕业生可以提前申请注册，并在提交成绩前启动审查流程。如果你是即将毕业的澳大利亚 PT 学生，提前提交申请能显著加快你的执业速度。
items.titleZh: 毕业生可立即申请注册 – Ahpra
items.summaryZh: Ahpra 宣布，澳大利亚的医疗专业毕业生可以在完成学业前申请注册，以便提前进行评估并更快进入职场。该过程包括设置在线门户、提交文件和支付费用，并在收到毕业成绩后两周内完成。
items.curatedReasonEn: AHPRA has announced that Australian health professional graduates can apply for registration early, initiating the review process before submitting results. If you are an Australian PT student about to graduate, submitting your application early can significantly expedite your entry into practice.

items.title: How to ensure the implementability of multi-component interventions to improve active ageing in older people? An overview of the evidence of systematic reviews
items.summary: An overview of 8 systematic reviews on multi-component interventions for active aging found inconsistent reporting and operationalization of implementation outcomes, with acceptability being consistently reported, while appropriateness and feasibility were least frequently evaluated. RE-AIM and Proctor’s framework were the most commonly used implementation theories.
items.curatedReason: 这项综述提示，尽管有多种框架用于主动老龄化干预，但实施效果的衡量和报告仍然高度异质且依赖替代指标。这提醒你在评估和设计多组分干预时，需更清晰地定义和测量实施终点，而不是仅仅关注干预本身。
items.titleZh: 如何确保多组分干预措施在改善老年人积极老龄化方面的可实施性？系统综述证据概述
items.summaryZh: 一项关于积极老龄化多组分干预的8项系统综述概述发现，实施结果的报告和操作化不一致，可接受性一致被报告，而适宜性和可行性评估最少。RE-AIM和Proctor框架是最常用的实施理论。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review indicates that despite various frameworks for active aging interventions, the measurement and reporting of implementation outcomes remain highly heterogeneous and reliant on proxy indicators. This highlights the need for clearer definition and measurement of implementation endpoints when evaluating and designing multi-component interventions, rather than solely focusing on the intervention itself.
items.limitation: 研究仅纳入了系统综述和范围综述，可能无法捕捉到初级研究层面的所有实施细节。
items.limitationEn: The study only included systematic reviews and scoping reviews, which may not capture all implementation details at the primary study level.

items.title: Effects of thoracic kinesiological taping on pulmonary functions, respiratory muscle strength, and functional independence in patients with hemiplegia: a randomized controlled clinical trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=30) found that thoracic kinesiology taping (KT) combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improved pulmonary function (FVC, FEV1, PEF, MIP, all p<0.001) and functional independence (FIM, p=0.029) in chronic post-stroke hemiplegia patients compared to sham taping, with greater changes in the KT group.
items.curatedReason: 本 RCT 首次证明胸部肌内效贴与常规康复结合，能显著改善慢性卒中偏瘫患者的肺功能、吸气肌力量和功能独立性，提示其作为神经康复辅助手段的潜力。
items.titleZh: 胸部肌内效贴对偏瘫患者肺功能、呼吸肌力量和功能独立性的影响：一项随机对照临床试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=30）发现，与假贴组相比，胸部肌内效贴结合常规康复治疗能显著改善慢性卒中偏瘫患者的肺功能（FVC、FEV1、PEF、MIP，p<0.001）和功能独立性（FIM，p=0.029）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT is the first to demonstrate that thoracic kinesiology taping, combined with conventional rehabilitation, significantly improves pulmonary function, inspiratory muscle strength, and functional independence in chronic post-stroke hemiplegia patients, suggesting its potential as an adjunct in neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（30例），随访时间较短（4周），且对MEP的改善效果不如对照组，长期效应和普适性仍需更多研究验证。
items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size (30 patients) and short follow-up (4 weeks). The improvement in MEP was inferior to the control group, and long-term effects and generalizability require further validation.

items.title: Comparison of kinesio taping and myofascial release therapy in cervicogenic headache: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=81) found that both kinesio taping (KT) and myofascial release (MFR) combined with home exercise significantly improved pain, disability, quality of life, and headache frequency in cervicogenic headache patients over 4 weeks compared to home exercise alone. MFR showed more sustained improvements in disability and physical quality of life at one-month follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证据坐实了肌内效贴和筋膜松解术在结合居家锻炼时，对颈源性头痛的短期止痛和功能改善是有效的，并提示筋膜松解术在改善残疾和生活质量方面可能具有更持久的优势。
items.titleZh: 肌内效贴与筋膜松解疗法治疗颈源性头痛的比较：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=81）发现，与单纯居家锻炼相比，肌内效贴（KT）和筋膜松解（MFR）结合居家锻炼，在4周内显著改善了颈源性头痛患者的疼痛、残疾、生活质量和头痛频率。MFR在1个月随访时在残疾和身体生活质量方面显示出更持久的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT evidence confirms that kinesio taping and myofascial release, when combined with home exercise, are effective for short-term pain relief and functional improvement in cervicogenic headache. It also suggests that myofascial release may offer more sustained benefits in improving disability and quality of life.
items.limitation: 研究的随访期较短（仅1个月），无法评估长期疗效；且未具体说明两种干预与居家锻炼的交互作用。
items.limitationEn: The study's follow-up period was short (only 1 month), preventing evaluation of long-term efficacy. It also did not specify the interaction between the two interventions and home exercise.

items.title: Relaxation interventions in neurological rehabilitation: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified 63 sources on relaxation interventions in neurological rehabilitation, primarily in multiple sclerosis and stroke patients. Interventions are generally feasible and well-accepted, with outcomes mostly assessed at the body structure and function level, particularly psychological functioning, but noted a heterogeneous evidence landscape and key research gaps.
items.curatedReason: 在神经康复中，放松干预措施的可行性和接受度普遍较高，但其有效性证据仍分散且多关注心理功能。这份综述提示我们，在将其广泛应用于临床前，还需要更多高质量研究来明确这些干预措施在具体疾病和功能层面的确切疗效，而非仅限于心理层面。
items.titleZh: 神经康复中的放松干预：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述纳入了63项关于神经康复中放松干预的研究，主要集中在多发性硬化症和卒中患者。研究发现这些干预措施通常可行且接受度高，结果主要评估身体结构和功能层面，尤其心理功能，但证据存在异质性且研究空白较多。
items.curatedReasonEn: Relaxation interventions in neurorehabilitation are generally feasible and well-accepted, but evidence for their efficacy remains fragmented and largely focused on psychological outcomes. This review suggests that before widespread clinical adoption, more high-quality research is needed to define the precise therapeutic effects of these interventions across specific conditions and functional levels, beyond just psychological benefits.
items.limitation: 该综述揭示了现有证据的异质性，并指出在研究不常见神经疾病、采用定性设计和比较效果研究以及评估感知生理压力、活动和参与方面存在显著空白。
items.limitationEn: The review highlights the heterogeneity of existing evidence and significant gaps in research for less prevalent neurological conditions, qualitative designs, comparative effectiveness studies, and assessments of perceived physiological stress, activities, and participation.

items.title: An exploration of self-evaluation of induced temporal and spatial gait asymmetry in neurotypical young adults.
items.summary: A study in 33 neurotypical young adults found that self-evaluation of temporal gait asymmetry (TGA) was more accurate than spatial gait asymmetry (SGA), with lower odds of correctness for SGA (OR = 0.09 for presence, 0.18 for direction). Directing attention to the swing phase facilitated more accurate TGA self-evaluation (OR = 0.13 for single limb stance vs. swing time).
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究揭示了健康年轻人对步态时间不对称的自我评估比空间不对称更准确，并且将注意力引导至摆动相能提高准确性。这些发现对未来卒中患者步态不对称的外部反馈干预设计具有指导意义。
items.titleZh: 神经正常年轻成人对诱发性步态时间与空间不对称的自我评估探索。
items.summaryZh: 一项对33名神经正常年轻成人进行的研究发现，对步态时间不对称（TGA）的自我评估比空间不对称（SGA）更准确，SGA的正确评估几率较低（存在不对称OR=0.09，方向OR=0.18）。将注意力引导至摆动相有助于更准确地自我评估TGA（单腿站立与摆动时间相比OR=0.13）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study reveals that healthy young adults are more accurate at self-evaluating temporal gait asymmetry than spatial asymmetry, and directing attention to the swing phase can improve accuracy. These findings are instructive for designing future extrinsic feedback interventions for gait asymmetry in stroke patients.
items.limitation: 研究仅在神经正常年轻成人中进行，结果在卒中患者中是否适用，以及这些自我评估准确性的生理机制尚待进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted only in neurotypical young adults, and its applicability to stroke patients, as well as the physiological mechanisms behind these self-evaluation accuracies, require further investigation.

items.title: Engagement strategies to support sub-acute, post-stroke upper limb interventions: A co-design study.
items.summary: A four-stage integrated knowledge translation co-design study, involving 30 knowledge-users (stroke survivors, clinicians, and scientists), developed 10 clinician-delivered strategies to support stroke survivor engagement during sub-acute, face-to-face upper limb rehabilitation. Personalization, applied through timing and emphasis, was identified as the governing principle.
items.curatedReason: 这项协同设计研究为亚急性卒中上肢康复制定了以患者为中心的参与策略，强调个性化原则。虽然尚未经过临床实践检验，但它为PTs提供了如何提升患者依从性的新思路。
items.titleZh: 亚急性卒中后上肢干预的依从性策略：一项协同设计研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项四阶段整合知识转化协同设计研究，涉及30名知识使用者（卒中幸存者、临床医生和科学家），制定了10项由临床医生提供的策略，以支持亚急性、面对面卒中上肢康复期间患者的依从性。研究确定了通过时机和强调实现的个性化是指导原则。
items.curatedReasonEn: This co-design study developed patient-centered engagement strategies for sub-acute post-stroke upper limb rehabilitation, emphasizing personalization. While not yet clinically tested, it offers new ideas for PTs on how to enhance patient adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究的策略是协同设计的产物，其在临床实践中的可行性仍有待测试。
items.limitationEn: The strategies in this study were developed through co-design, and their feasibility in clinical practice remains to be tested.

items.title: Rehabilitation of Athletes With Hamstring Strain Injury: SONAFE-Brazil Clinical Practice Guideline.
items.summary: The National Society of Sports Physical Therapy (SONAFE-Brazil) developed a clinical practice guideline using the GRADE approach to provide evidence-based recommendations for physical therapists on interventions to improve rehabilitation outcomes in athletes with hamstring strain injury.
items.curatedReason: 这份 SONAFE-Brazil 临床实践指南基于 GRADE 方法，可信度高。对腘绳肌拉伤运动员，请直接参考指南中的证据和具体建议，从而优化康复方案。
items.titleZh: 运动员腘绳肌拉伤的康复：SONAFE-Brazil 临床实践指南。
items.summaryZh: 巴西国家运动物理治疗学会（SONAFE-Brazil）发布了临床实践指南，采用 GRADE 方法为物理治疗师提供基于证据的建议，以改善腘绳肌拉伤运动员的康复效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This SONAFE-Brazil clinical practice guideline, developed with the GRADE approach, is highly reliable. For athletes with hamstring strain injury, directly apply the evidence and specific recommendations from this guideline to optimize rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 指南的推荐是基于现有随机临床试验的证据，未来仍可能因更高级别研究的出现而更新。
items.limitationEn: The guideline's recommendations are based on evidence from existing randomized clinical trials and may be updated in the future as higher-level studies emerge.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Reframing hands-on musculoskeletal assessment as a measurement instrument rather than a technique debate: a theoretical framework applying COSMIN to HODA-A.
items.summary: A theoretical framework proposes conceptualizing hands-on musculoskeletal examination as a clinician-reported outcome measurement process, applying COSMIN principles to enhance scientific rigor by defining constructs, content validity, and examiner calibration.
items.curatedReason: 这项理论框架提出，将徒手评估视为临床医生报告结果的测量工具，有助于我们提升评估的科学严谨性。按 COSMIN 标准重新审视徒手评估，能帮你更系统化地验证其内容效度和考官校准，最终加强你评估结果的可靠性。
items.titleZh: 将徒手肌肉骨骼评估重新定义为测量工具而非技术争议：COSMIN 在 HODA-A 中应用的理论框架。
items.summaryZh: 这项理论框架提出，将徒手肌肉骨骼检查和评估概念化为临床医生报告结果的测量过程，并应用 COSMIN 原则来提升科学严谨性，强调了构建定义、内容效度和考官校准的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This theoretical framework re-conceptualizes hands-on assessment as a clinician-reported outcome measure, which will help you enhance the scientific rigor of your assessments. By applying COSMIN principles, you can systematically validate its content validity and examiner calibration, ultimately improving the reliability of your assessment findings.
items.limitation: 这是一篇理论性文章，尚未进行实际的验证研究。
items.limitationEn: This is a theoretical paper and does not involve empirical validation research.

items.title: Is Reduced Spinal Range of Motion a Prognostic Factor for Pain Intensity, Disability, and Global Recovery in People With Specific or Nonspecific Spinal Pain? A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review of 37 studies found very low certainty evidence, with all studies rated high risk of bias, making it unclear whether reduced spinal range of motion independently predicts pain, disability, and global recovery in individuals with specific or nonspecific spinal pain.
items.curatedReason: 脊柱活动度受限能否预测疼痛强度、残疾和整体恢复，目前证据确定性极低。别再把活动度当成脊柱疼痛患者预后的独立预测因素来过度解读，它不是一个可靠的预后指标。
items.titleZh: 脊柱活动度受限是特异性或非特异性脊柱疼痛患者疼痛强度、残疾和整体恢复的预后因素吗？一项系统综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 37 项研究的系统综述发现，证据确定性极低，所有研究均被评为高偏倚风险，因此不清楚脊柱活动度受限是否能独立预测特异性或非特异性脊柱疼痛患者的疼痛、残疾和整体恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: The evidence for whether reduced spinal ROM predicts pain intensity, disability, and global recovery is very uncertain. Avoid over-interpreting ROM as an independent prognostic factor for spinal pain patients; it is not a reliable prognostic indicator.
items.limitation: 纳入的 37 项研究均被评为高偏倚风险，且结果存在高度异质性，限制了结论的可靠性。
items.limitationEn: All 37 included studies were rated as high risk of bias, and results showed high heterogeneity, limiting the reliability of the conclusions.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Dextrose prolotherapy for chronic symptomatic rotator cuff tendinopathy and subacromial bursitis: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 studies (13 RCTs, 1 observational) found very low to low certainty evidence that dextrose prolotherapy may offer little to no benefit for chronic symptomatic rotator cuff tendinopathy and/or subacromial bursitis compared to normal saline, and probably results in worse physical performance compared to corticosteroid injections.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性症状性肩袖肌腱病和肩峰下滑囊炎，葡萄糖增生疗法效果存疑，甚至可能不如皮质类固醇注射。在当前证据等级下，不宜将其作为常规干预手段。
items.titleZh: 葡萄糖增生疗法治疗慢性症状性肩袖肌腱病和肩峰下滑囊炎：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 14 项研究（13 项 RCTs，1 项观察性研究）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，对于慢性症状性肩袖肌腱病和/或肩峰下滑囊炎，与生理盐水相比，葡萄糖增生疗法可能几乎没有益处，且与皮质类固醇注射相比，其物理表现可能更差，证据确定性为极低至低。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic symptomatic rotator cuff tendinopathy and subacromial bursitis, dextrose prolotherapy shows uncertain benefits and may even be worse than corticosteroid injections. Given the current evidence, it should not be considered a routine intervention.
items.limitation: 纳入的 14 项研究中，10 项存在高偏倚风险，且研究规模普遍偏小（n=12-129）且随访期短（10 项 < 6 个月），限制了证据的确定性。
items.limitationEn: Ten of the 14 included studies had a high risk of bias, and studies were generally small (n=12-129) with short follow-up periods (10 studies < 6 months), limiting the certainty of evidence.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Methodological quality of systematic reviews on treatments in stroke rehabilitation: A cross-sectional study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study appraised 140 systematic reviews on stroke rehabilitation treatments published between 2021 and 2023, finding that only 1.4% were of high methodological quality, with 92.9% rated as critically low, highlighting significant methodological flaws.
items.curatedReason: 卒中康复治疗领域系统综述的方法学质量令人担忧，92.9% 的综述被评为极低质量。在参考卒中康复领域证据时，务必高度警惕其研究方法、资金来源和文献检索的全面性，不能盲信综述结论。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复治疗系统综述的方法学质量：一项横断面研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究评估了 2021 年至 2023 年发表的 140 篇卒中康复治疗系统综述，发现仅 1.4% 的综述方法学质量高，92.9% 被评为极低质量，凸显了严重的方法学缺陷。
items.curatedReasonEn: The methodological quality of systematic reviews in stroke rehabilitation is concerning, with 92.9% rated as critically low. When referring to evidence in stroke rehabilitation, be highly cautious about study methods, funding sources, and literature search comprehensiveness; do not blindly trust review conclusions.
items.limitation: 研究样本仅限于 2021 年至 2023 年发表的系统综述，可能无法完全代表整个卒中康复领域所有综述的质量。
items.limitationEn: The study sample was limited to systematic reviews published between January 2021 and September 2023, which may not fully represent the quality of all reviews in stroke rehabilitation.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Patients' experiences of participating in physiotherapeutic telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction; a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 14 women in Sweden found that telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction was perceived as a beneficial complement to in-person visits, improving accessibility and continuity of care, despite concerns about physical examination and hands-on guidance.
items.curatedReason: 本项定性研究提示，远程康复是产后盆底功能障碍患者物理治疗的有效补充，提高了可及性和依从性。尽管患者担忧缺乏体格检查和手把手指导，混合模式仍能优化以患者为中心的护理。
items.titleZh: 产后盆底功能障碍患者参与物理治疗远程康复的体验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对瑞典 14 名女性的定性研究发现，产后盆底功能障碍的远程康复被视为面对面就诊的有效补充，改善了可及性和护理的连续性，尽管患者对缺乏体格检查和手把手指导有所担忧。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study suggests telerehabilitation is an effective complement to physical therapy for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction, improving accessibility and adherence. Despite patient concerns about the lack of physical examination and hands-on guidance, a hybrid model can optimize person-centered care.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative study with a small sample size, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Association between hospital-level factors and early rehabilitation initiation in patients with acute ischemic stroke: a multilevel analysis using a Japanese administrative database from a rural prefecture.
items.summary: A multilevel analysis of 17,194 acute ischemic stroke patients in Japan found that providing weekend rehabilitation services was significantly associated with early rehabilitation initiation (incidence rate ratio, 1.65; 95% CI, 1.21-2.25), while therapist staffing levels and stroke volume were not.
items.curatedReason: 针对急性缺血性卒中，应优先考虑在周末提供康复服务，这与早期康复启动显著相关（IRR 1.65）。而治疗师人员配置或卒中病例量，对早期康复启动的影响并不像你想象的那么大。
items.titleZh: 日本农村地区行政数据库多水平分析：医院层面因素与急性缺血性卒中患者早期康复启动的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项对日本 17194 名急性缺血性卒中患者的多水平分析发现，提供周末康复服务与早期康复启动显著相关（发生率比 1.65；95% CI，1.21-2.25），而治疗师配备水平和卒中病例量则无此关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: For acute ischemic stroke, prioritize offering weekend rehabilitation services, as this is significantly associated with early rehabilitation initiation (IRR 1.65). Therapist staffing levels or stroke volume do not influence early initiation as much as you might expect.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且数据来自日本一个农村县，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional study, which limits causal inference, and data from a rural prefecture in Japan may limit generalizability.

items.title: Single Ultrasound-Guided Dextrose Prolotherapy Plus Therapeutic Exercise for Subacromial-Subdeltoid Bursitis: A Pilot Double-Blind Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: A pilot double-blind randomized controlled trial is being conducted to evaluate the efficacy of single ultrasound-guided dextrose prolotherapy combined with therapeutic exercise for subacromial-subdeltoid bursitis.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步的随机对照试验正在探索超声引导的右旋糖增生疗法结合治疗性运动治疗肩峰下三角肌滑囊炎的效果。虽然结果尚未发布，但这类结合注射与主动康复的研究方向值得你关注。
items.titleZh: 超声引导下右旋糖增生疗法结合治疗性运动治疗肩峰下三角肌滑囊炎：一项初步双盲随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项初步的双盲随机对照试验正在进行中，旨在评估超声引导下的单次右旋糖增生疗法结合治疗性运动治疗肩峰下三角肌滑囊炎的疗效。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT for subacromial-subdeltoid bursitis, though results are pending, is worth watching for its approach combining ultrasound-guided dextrose prolotherapy with therapeutic exercise. Future findings could inform your assessment of combining injections with active rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 作为一项初步研究，其结论强度和外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: As a pilot study, its conclusiveness and generalizability are limited.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Diagnostic Performance of Ultrasonographic Median Nerve Cross-Sectional Area for Carpal Tunnel Syndrome in Wheelchair Users With Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: A prospective cross-sectional study of 67 wheelchair users with SCI evaluated ultrasonographic median nerve cross-sectional area (CSA-M) for carpal tunnel syndrome, finding a moderate diagnostic accuracy (AuROC 0.76). A 10 mm² cutoff yielded 90.5% sensitivity and 45.2% specificity; 15 mm² yielded 33.3% sensitivity and 91.7% specificity.
items.curatedReason: 超声正中神经横截面积（CSA-M）在中度诊断脊髓损伤轮椅使用者的腕管综合征方面具有中等准确性。10 mm² 作为截断值时，筛查敏感性高；而 15 mm² 时，特异性更高。这些数据可辅助你针对这类高危人群进行更精准的诊断评估。
items.titleZh: 超声正中神经横截面积诊断脊髓损伤轮椅使用者腕管综合征的诊断效能
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 67 名脊髓损伤轮椅使用者的前瞻性横断面研究评估了超声正中神经横截面积（CSA-M）诊断腕管综合征的效能，发现中等诊断准确性（AuROC 0.76）。10 mm² 的截断值敏感性为 90.5%，特异性为 45.2%；15 mm² 敏感性为 33.3%，特异性为 91.7%。
items.curatedReasonEn: Ultrasonographic median nerve cross-sectional area (CSA-M) demonstrates moderate diagnostic accuracy for carpal tunnel syndrome in wheelchair users with spinal cord injury. A cutoff of 10 mm² favors screening sensitivity, while 15 mm² improves diagnostic specificity. This data can aid in more precise diagnostic evaluations for this high-risk population.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（67 名参与者），且数据来自单一大学医院，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study included a relatively small sample size (67 participants) and data from a single university hospital, which may affect generalizability.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: "It's a black box": Physiotherapists' perspectives on sensorimotor control and the use of technology in this context to improve rehabilitation following ACL injury.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 22 physiotherapists found interest in using technology for sensorimotor assessment and rehabilitation after ACL injury, but also concerns regarding the clinical value of sensorimotor outcomes and seamless integration with existing clinical workflows.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了物理治疗师在 ACL 损伤康复中对传感器运动控制评估和技术应用的看法。治疗师普遍对技术辅助评估和训练持开放态度，但担忧传感器运动控制结果的临床价值和与现有工作流程的整合。你需要关注该领域未来技术发展如何与临床实践更好地结合。
items.titleZh: “这是一个黑箱”：物理治疗师对传感器运动控制和技术在 ACL 损伤康复中应用的看法
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 22 名物理治疗师的定性研究发现，治疗师对在 ACL 损伤康复中使用技术进行传感器运动控制评估和训练感兴趣，但同时担忧传感器运动控制结果的临床价值以及与现有临床工作流程的无缝整合。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals physical therapists' perspectives on sensorimotor control assessment and technology use in ACL injury rehabilitation. Therapists are generally open to technology-assisted assessment and training but are concerned about the clinical value of sensorimotor outcomes and integration with existing workflows. You should monitor how future technological developments in this area can better integrate with clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性设计，样本量小，且参与者来自特定背景，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative study with a small sample size and participants from specific backgrounds, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Absolute Test-Retest Reliability of the Sit-And-Reach Tests in Healthy Individuals: A Systematic Review with Meta-Analysis
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analysis is being conducted to evaluate the absolute test-retest reliability of the sit-and-reach tests in healthy individuals.
items.curatedReason: 坐位体前屈测试在健康人群中的绝对重测可靠性，即将通过这项系统综述和荟萃分析得以明确。届时，你就能更精准地掌握这一常用柔韧性评估工具的测量误差和稳定性，优化你的评估和康复进度监测。
items.titleZh: 健康个体坐位体前屈测试的绝对重测可靠性：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析正在进行中，旨在评估健康个体坐位体前屈测试的绝对重测可靠性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The absolute test-retest reliability of sit-and-reach tests in healthy individuals will be clarified by this upcoming systematic review and meta-analysis. Once available, you'll have a more precise understanding of this common flexibility assessment tool's measurement error and stability, helping you optimize assessments and monitor rehabilitation progress.
items.limitation: 本条目是待发表的系统综述，尚未有具体结果可供评估其局限性。
items.limitationEn: This entry is for a forthcoming systematic review, and no specific results are available to assess its limitations yet.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Mirror therapy versus functional electrical stimulation cycling in post-stroke lower limb rehabilitation: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: In subacute stroke, both mirror therapy and functional electrical stimulation-assisted cycling (FES-C) significantly improved lower extremity motor function (ΔFMA-LE scores: MD -2.60 for MT, MD -3.00 for FES-C, both p<0.05 vs control), with FES-C showing additional gains in Brunnstrom stage and SS-QOL.
items.curatedReason: 对于亚急性卒中偏瘫患者的下肢康复，镜面疗法和功能性电刺激辅助循环训练都能有效改善运动功能。特别是当你受限于技术设备或预算时，镜面疗法是一个简单且易于实施的有效辅助干预。
items.titleZh: 镜面疗法对比功能性电刺激辅助循环训练在卒中后下肢康复中的应用：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 在亚急性卒中患者中，镜面疗法和功能性电刺激辅助循环训练均显著改善下肢运动功能（ΔFMA-LE评分：MT组MD -2.60，FES-C组MD -3.00，均P<0.05 vs 对照组），其中FES-C在Brunnstrom分期和SS-QOL方面有额外获益。
items.curatedReasonEn: For lower limb rehabilitation in subacute stroke hemiplegia, both mirror therapy and functional electrical stimulation-assisted cycling effectively improve motor function. Mirror therapy is a simple and accessible effective adjunct intervention, especially when you are limited by technological equipment or budget.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心小样本随机对照试验，结果外推需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center, small-sample randomized controlled trial, and the generalizability of results should be considered with caution.

items.title: The enhanced rehabilitation programme for significant musculoskeletal injuries from the manchester arena bombing - A process evaluation study investigating patients' and physiotherapists' experiences.
items.summary: A process evaluation of the Enhanced Rehabilitation Programme (ERP) for Manchester Arena bombing survivors, using the Normalisation Process Theory, found it valuable but identified challenges in sustaining progress and transitioning back to standard NHS care.
items.curatedReason: 曼彻斯特爆炸案后的强化康复项目（ERP）展示了结构化、多学科康复模式对创伤幸存者的潜力。但在将这类模式更广泛地整合到现有体系时，你仍需考虑资源限制和长期康复路径的持续性问题。
items.titleZh: 曼彻斯特竞技场爆炸案严重肌肉骨骼损伤强化康复项目：一项调查患者和物理治疗师体验的过程评估研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对曼彻斯特竞技场爆炸案幸存者的强化康复项目（ERP）的过程评估研究发现，该项目具有价值，但也指出了在维持康复进展和过渡回NHS常规护理方面的挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Enhanced Rehabilitation Programme (ERP) after the Manchester bombing demonstrates the potential of structured, multidisciplinary rehabilitation models for trauma survivors. However, when integrating such models more broadly into existing systems, you still need to consider resource limitations and the sustainability of long-term rehabilitation pathways.
items.limitation: 本研究是小样本定性研究，患者和物理治疗师的经验可能不完全代表更广泛人群。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample qualitative study, and the experiences of patients and physiotherapists may not fully represent a broader population.

items.title: Not Just Faster Horses: Telerehabilitation as a Necessary Evolution in Physical Therapy.
items.summary: This editorial argues that telerehabilitation is a necessary evolution in musculoskeletal physical therapy, extending the therapist's role through continuous monitoring, communication, education, and patient engagement, rather than merely replacing traditional care.
items.curatedReason: 远程康复不再仅仅是传统面对面治疗的替代方案，而是物理治疗未来交付模式的必要演进。它要求你不仅掌握技术，还要发展新的临床技能和适应性执业习惯，以保持治疗关系和患者为中心的护理。
items.titleZh: 不只是更快的马：远程康复作为物理治疗的必要演进。
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评指出，远程康复是肌肉骨骼物理治疗的必要演进，它通过持续监测、沟通、教育和患者参与来扩展物理治疗师的角色，而非仅仅替代传统护理。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telerehabilitation is no longer merely an alternative to traditional in-person therapy but a necessary evolution in future physical therapy delivery models. It requires you not only to master technology but also to develop new clinical skills and adaptive practice habits to maintain therapeutic relationships and patient-centered care.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Rehabilitation after stroke for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and Indigenous peoples globally: a scoping review and critical content analysis.
items.summary: A scoping review of 108 sources found that stroke rehabilitation for Indigenous peoples globally is significantly influenced by ongoing colonization and Western health paradigms, highlighting the need for culturally informed care.
items.curatedReason: 为原住民患者提供卒中康复服务时，你必须认识到其疗效正被殖民化历史和主导性的西方健康范式显著削弱。你需要将原住民的文化模型和知识体系整合到康复路径中，方能提供真正以人为本的适宜护理。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚原住民、托雷斯海峡岛民及全球原住民卒中康复：一项范围审查和批判性内容分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖108份文献的范围审查发现，全球原住民的卒中康复受持续殖民化和西方健康范式显著影响，凸显了文化知情护理的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: When rehabilitating Indigenous stroke patients, understand that ongoing colonization and Western health paradigms significantly undermine your efforts. Integrate Indigenous cultural models and knowledge systems into the rehabilitation pathway to deliver truly person-centered, appropriate care.
items.limitation: 本综述包含多种研究类型，且未能提供量化效应评估，其结论主要为定性描述。
items.limitationEn: This review includes various study types and does not provide quantitative effect assessments, with its conclusions primarily being qualitative descriptions.

items.title: Return to sports after lumbar disc herniation surgery: a survey of German surgeons and postoperative patient experiences.
items.summary: A survey of German surgeons found high variability in recommendations for return to sport after lumbar disc herniation surgery, with most suggesting regular activity from 8 weeks. This contrasted with patient-reported return in 12.1 ± 11.7 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 腰椎间盘突出症术后重返运动的指导缺乏证据支持，导致外科医生建议差异大。患者实际重返运动的时间往往晚于外科医生建议，这表明你需要更细致地与患者沟通预期，并在术后康复中采用循证方法。
items.titleZh: 腰椎间盘突出症术后重返运动：德国外科医生调查与患者术后体验。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对德国外科医生的调查发现，腰椎间盘突出症术后重返运动的建议存在很大差异，多数建议在术后8周开始常规活动。这与患者报告的12.1 ± 11.7周的实际重返时间形成对比。
items.curatedReasonEn: Guidance for return to sport after lumbar disc herniation surgery lacks evidence, leading to wide variability in surgeon recommendations. Patients often return to sport later than recommended, indicating that you need to communicate expectations more thoroughly with patients and adopt evidence-based approaches in postoperative rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究是两个独立调查数据集的比较，存在设计和背景差异，可能无法直接对比。且患者数据为单中心队列。
items.limitationEn: This study compares two independent survey datasets with differences in design and setting, which may not be directly comparable. Patient data is also from a single-center cohort.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Quantifying Static Postural Control Impairment after Stroke using Markerless Motion Capture
items.summary: This study evaluated markerless motion capture for quantifying static postural control impairment in 26 individuals with subacute stroke and 171 healthy controls, finding 46% of stroke participants impaired with significant correlations to Berg Balance Scale (r = -0.64 to -0.81) and FIM Motor scores.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，无标记运动捕捉技术能有效量化卒中后的静态姿势控制障碍，为临床评估提供了潜在的新工具。在实际应用中，评估该技术在动态任务中的表现将是下一步关键。
items.titleZh: 使用无标记运动捕捉技术量化卒中后静态姿势控制障碍
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了无标记运动捕捉技术在量化亚急性卒中患者（n=26）静态姿势控制障碍方面的效用，发现 46% 的卒中患者存在障碍，且与 Berg 平衡量表（r = -0.64 至 -0.81）和 FIM 运动评分存在显著相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that markerless motion capture effectively quantifies static postural control impairment post-stroke, offering a potential new tool for clinical assessment. Further evaluating its performance in dynamic tasks will be crucial for practical application.
items.limitation: 本研究仅评估了静态姿势控制，未扩展到动态姿势控制和步态任务。
items.limitationEn: This study only evaluated static postural control and did not extend to dynamic postural control and gait tasks.

items.title: 2026 registration renewal now open
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) has opened 2026 registration renewal for various health professions, including physiotherapists, with a deadline of November 30 to avoid late fees.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚 AHPRA 已开放 2026 年度执业注册续期。如果您是澳大利亚执业治疗师，请务必在 11 月 30 日前完成续期，以免产生滞纳金或影响执业资格。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者管理局（AHPRA）2026 年执业注册续期现已开放
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者管理局（AHPRA）已开放包括物理治疗师在内的多个健康专业的 2026 年执业注册续期，截止日期为 11 月 30 日，逾期将产生滞纳金。
items.curatedReasonEn: AHPRA has opened 2026 registration renewal in Australia. If you are a practicing therapist in Australia, ensure you renew by November 30 to avoid late fees or impact on your practicing eligibility.

items.title: Advocacy by Physical Therapy Students Generates 14,500-plus Letters to Congress
items.summary: APTA's Flash Action Strategy in September 2026 mobilized physical therapy students to send over 14,500 letters to Congress, advocating for the bipartisan Physical Therapist Workforce and Patient Access Act (H.R. 5621/S. 4420).
items.curatedReason: APTA 学生倡导活动成功促使国会议员收到超过 14,500 封信函，支持《物理治疗师劳动力与患者准入法案》。这表明 PT 行业，特别是学生群体，在政策倡导方面的集体力量不容小觑。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗学生倡导行动向国会提交逾 14,500 封信函
items.summaryZh: APTA 于 2026 年 9 月的“快速行动策略”动员物理治疗学生向国会发送了超过 14,500 封信函，旨在倡导两党支持的《物理治疗师劳动力与患者准入法案》（H.R. 5621/S. 4420）。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA's student advocacy campaign successfully generated over 14,500 letters to Congress supporting the Physical Therapist Workforce and Patient Access Act. This demonstrates the significant collective power of the PT profession, especially among students, in policy advocacy.

items.title: A commentary on methodological issues in research on rehabilitation needs after moderate-to-severe traumatic injury: lessons learned from quantitative and qualitative studies in Norway
items.summary: This commentary discusses methodological issues in research on rehabilitation needs after moderate-to-severe traumatic injury, drawing lessons from quantitative and qualitative studies in Norway.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评剖析了中度至重度创伤后康复需求研究中的方法学挑战。它提醒您在解读相关文献时，需要更批判性地审视研究设计和数据质量，以避免在制定康复策略时出现误判。
items.titleZh: 中度至重度创伤后康复需求研究中的方法学问题评述：来自挪威定量和定性研究的经验教训
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评讨论了中度至重度创伤后康复需求研究中的方法学问题，并借鉴了挪威定量和定性研究的经验教训。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary dissects methodological challenges in research on rehabilitation needs after moderate-to-severe traumatic injury. It urges you to critically examine research designs and data quality when interpreting relevant literature to avoid misjudgments in developing rehabilitation strategies.

items.title: How Will Healthcare Trends Shape Rehab Therapy in 2027—and Beyond?
items.summary: WebPT forecasts that healthcare trends for 2027 will see rising payer costs (9% increase) and inflation driving up practice expenses and potentially reducing patient visits in rehab therapy, necessitating proactive planning for utilization management and operational costs.
items.curatedReason: WebPT 对 2027 年康复治疗行业的趋势预测，指出支付方成本上升和通货膨胀将继续挤压利润空间，并可能影响患者就诊。您需要提前规划，以应对可能更严格的利用管理和更高的运营成本。
items.titleZh: 医疗趋势如何塑造 2027 年及以后的康复治疗行业？
items.summaryZh: WebPT 预测 2027 年医疗趋势将导致支付方成本上升（增加 9%）和通货膨胀推高康复治疗机构的运营成本，并可能减少患者就诊，这要求治疗师对利用管理和运营成本进行前瞻性规划。
items.curatedReasonEn: WebPT's forecast for 2027 rehab therapy trends suggests rising payer costs and inflation will continue to squeeze profit margins and potentially affect patient visits. You need to plan ahead to cope with potentially stricter utilization management and higher operating costs.

items.title: Cryoneurolysis as an effective spasticity treatment option
items.summary: This case series (n=8) explored cryoneurolysis as a spasticity treatment option, finding immediate benefits lasting a few months to one year in patients with neuropathic gait, lower extremity pain, weakness, and spasticity after targeted nerve freezing.
items.curatedReason: 冷冻神经溶解术作为痉挛治疗的潜在方案，在这项小样本病例系列中显示出短期到中期的效果。但由于证据级别较低，目前仍应将其视为辅助性或实验性干预，不宜作为常规一线治疗。
items.titleZh: 冷冻神经溶解术作为有效的痉挛治疗选择：一个病例系列报告
items.summaryZh: 本病例系列（n=8）探讨了冷冻神经溶解术作为痉挛治疗的选择，发现在对靶向神经进行冷冻后，神经病理性步态、下肢疼痛、无力和痉挛患者立即获得益处，并持续数月至一年。
items.curatedReasonEn: Cryoneurolysis, as a potential treatment option for spasticity, showed short- to mid-term effects in this small case series. However, due to the low level of evidence, it should still be considered an adjunctive or experimental intervention, not a routine first-line treatment.
items.limitation: 本研究是一个小样本病例系列，缺乏对照组，无法确立因果关系或评估长期疗效。
items.limitationEn: This study is a small case series lacking a control group, thus unable to establish causality or evaluate long-term efficacy.

items.title: Experiences of sexual rehabilitation post-stroke among LGBTQI+ stroke survivors and their partners: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative phenomenological study explored the experiences of 18 LGBTQI+ stroke survivors and 5 partners regarding post-stroke sexual rehabilitation. Key themes included sexuality being addressed post-stroke, negative interactions with health professionals, and sexuality being absent in rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 本定性研究揭示了 LGBTQI+ 卒中幸存者及其伴侣在性康复方面面临的独特挑战和负面医疗互动。在临床实践中，请务必使用包容性语言，避免臆断，并主动与患者及其伴侣探讨性健康议题，必要时寻求额外培训。
items.titleZh: LGBTQI+ 卒中幸存者及其伴侣的卒中后性康复经验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性现象学研究调查了 18 名 LGBTQI+ 卒中幸存者及其 5 名伴侣在卒中后性康复方面的经验。主要主题包括卒中后性行为被提及、与健康专业人员的负面互动以及康复中性行为的缺失。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals the unique challenges and negative healthcare interactions faced by LGBTQI+ stroke survivors and their partners regarding sexual rehabilitation. In clinical practice, ensure inclusive and non-assumptive communication, proactively address sexual health with patients and partners, and seek additional training as needed.
items.limitation: 本研究是定性设计，样本量较小（18 名幸存者，5 名伴侣），且未能充分代表 LGBTQI+ 群体中的所有亚群，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size (18 survivors, 5 partners) and limited representation of all LGBTQI+ subgroups, thus limiting generalizability.

items.title: Smartphone Applications for Assisting Outdoor and Indoor Navigation for Persons with Blindness or Low Vision
items.summary: Smartphone navigation applications are explored as tools to assist persons with blindness or low vision in outdoor and indoor navigation, promoting independent living. Clinicians can use this information to identify beneficial tools for patients.
items.curatedReason: 对于视障患者，智能手机导航应用是促进独立出行和社区参与的重要辅助工具。你可以利用这些信息，评估并推荐最适合患者需求的工具，提升他们的生活质量。
items.titleZh: 辅助盲人或低视力人士室内外导航的智能手机应用
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了智能手机导航应用如何帮助盲人或低视力人士进行室内外导航，以促进独立生活。临床医生可以利用这些信息为患者识别有益的工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with blindness or low vision, smartphone navigation apps are crucial for independent mobility and community participation. Use this information to evaluate and recommend the most suitable tools, directly enhancing their quality of life.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Repeated subgroup partitions preclude factor-specific inference for vagus nerve stimulation after stroke.
items.summary: A commentary suggests that repeated subgroup partitions in research on vagus nerve stimulation after stroke may hinder factor-specific inference.
items.curatedReason: 关于卒中后迷走神经刺激（VNS）的研究，该述评指出，重复的亚组划分可能会导致对因子特异性推断的混淆。在评估 VNS 这类复杂干预时，警惕过度解读或泛化特定亚组结果。
items.titleZh: 重复的亚组划分妨碍了卒中后迷走神经刺激因子特异性推断
items.summaryZh: 一项述评指出，卒中后迷走神经刺激（VNS）研究中重复的亚组划分，可能会妨碍对特定因子推断的有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights that repeated subgroup partitions in vagus nerve stimulation (VNS) research post-stroke can preclude factor-specific inference. Be cautious of over-interpreting or over-generalizing findings from specific subgroups when evaluating complex interventions like VNS.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: Response to the Letter to the Editor: "Repeated subgroup partitions preclude factor-specific inference for vagus nerve stimulation after stroke"

items.title: Interpreting Per-Protocol Efficacy Signals in a Pilot Trial of Inspiratory Muscle Training
items.summary: This commentary discusses the interpretation of per-protocol efficacy signals in a pilot trial of inspiratory muscle training (IMT) for patients with knee osteoarthritis awaiting total knee arthroplasty. It highlights that the statistically significant improvement in estimated maximal oxygen consumption (V̇O₂max) was derived from an analysis restricted to adherent participants, warranting clarification in interpreting the efficacy signal.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评提醒你，在解读一项关于吸气肌训练（IMT）用于全膝关节置换术前康复的初步试验结果时，应注意其"遵从方案"分析的局限性。虽然 IMT 显示出预期的效果，但由于该试验仅限于依从性高的参与者，你应谨慎将此结果推广到所有患者，尤其是在进行常规临床决策时。
items.titleZh: 解读一项吸气肌训练初步试验中的"遵从方案"疗效信号
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评讨论了如何解读一项关于吸气肌训练（IMT）用于膝骨关节炎患者全膝关节置换术前康复的初步试验中，"遵从方案"疗效信号。它强调估计的最大摄氧量（V̇O₂max）的统计学显著改善是基于对依从性高的参与者的分析，因此在解释疗效信号时需谨慎。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary reminds you to be cautious when interpreting results from a pilot trial on inspiratory muscle training (IMT) for preoperative total knee arthroplasty rehabilitation, especially regarding its per-protocol analysis. While IMT showed promising effects, the findings were restricted to adherent participants, so you should be careful in generalizing these results to all patients, particularly when making routine clinical decisions.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of iTBS and rTMS Combined with Robotic Rehabilitation on Ambulation and Lower Extremity Motor Function in Chronic SCI Patients.
items.summary: This single-center, single-blind RCT (n=30) found that both rTMS and iTBS combined with robotic rehabilitation improved lower-extremity motor function, SCIM III scores, and 10 MWT in chronic SCI patients, with median LEMS improvements of 4.0 and 5.0, respectively, versus 0.0 for sham, at 4-week follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性脊髓损伤患者，iTBS 和 rTMS 结合机器人康复均能改善下肢功能，效果与假刺激有显著差异。但两种主动方案之间效果无差异，提示选择时可根据患者具体情况和可及资源来定。
items.titleZh: iTBS 和 rTMS 联合机器人康复对慢性脊髓损伤患者步态和下肢运动功能的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项单中心、单盲随机对照试验（n=30）发现，对于慢性脊髓损伤患者，经颅磁刺激（rTMS）和间歇性θ字串爆发刺激（iTBS）联合机器人康复，均能改善下肢运动功能、SCIM III 评分和 10 米步行测试表现，其中 rTMS 组和 iTBS 组的 LEMS 中位改善值分别为 4.0 和 5.0，而假刺激组为 0.0。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both iTBS and rTMS combined with robotic rehabilitation significantly improved lower extremity function in chronic SCI patients compared to sham. However, no significant differences were observed between the two active protocols, suggesting patient-specific factors and resource availability can guide selection.
items.limitation: 研究为单中心、单盲设计，且样本量较小（n=30），结果外推需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study was a single-center, single-blind trial with a small sample size (n=30), limiting generalizability.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Shear wave elastography for assessing lower extremity muscle stiffness after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: A systematic review.
items.summary: A systematic review of six studies (n=173 ACLR, n=79 controls) found that shear wave elastography (SWE) consistently detected reduced passive vastus medialis shear modulus (Hedges' g -1.10 to -1.21) and semitendinosus stiffness (g -1.29 to -1.64 after hamstring harvest) in operative limbs after ACLR, linking these deficits to quadriceps strength, knee function, and landing biomechanics.
items.curatedReason: 剪切波弹性成像（SWE）能够发现 ACLR 术后患者的肌肉特异性机械缺陷，尤其是股内侧肌僵硬度降低，这可能解释了部分力量达标患者仍存在落地僵硬或再损伤风险的原因。这提示你除了力量评估，还应关注肌肉的机械特性。
items.titleZh: 剪切波弹性成像评估前交叉韧带重建术后下肢肌肉僵硬度的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对六项研究（173 名 ACLR 患者，79 名对照）的系统综述发现，前交叉韧带重建术后，手术肢体被持续检测出被动股内侧肌剪切模量降低（Hedges' g -1.10 至 -1.21）和半腱肌僵硬度降低（腘绳肌腱取用后 g -1.29 至 -1.64），这些缺陷与股四头肌力量、膝关节功能和落地生物力学相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Shear wave elastography (SWE) reveals muscle-specific mechanical deficits after ACLR, particularly reduced vastus medialis stiffness, which may explain why some strength-benchmark athletes still land stiffly or face re-injury risk. This suggests you should consider muscle mechanical properties beyond strength assessments.
items.limitation: 该系统综述纳入的六项研究质量从差到好不等，且缺乏标准化协议和对关键肌肉区域的采样，限制了 SWE 在康复指导中的即时应用。
items.limitationEn: The systematic review included six studies of varying quality (poor to good), and a lack of standardized protocols and sampling of clinically relevant muscle regions limits the immediate application of SWE in rehabilitation guidance.

items.title: Barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise among older adults following total knee arthroplasty: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 21 older adults post-total knee arthroplasty in China identified three themes and 10 subthemes regarding decision-making for home-based rehabilitation exercises, highlighting impulsive avoidance responses (e.g., pain, fear) as barriers and rational adherence (e.g., perceived threat of poor prognosis, goal-directed willpower) as facilitators.
items.curatedReason: 全膝关节置换术（TKA）后居家康复依从性受情绪和认知冲突影响。在指导老年患者时，你不仅要关注疼痛管理，还要通过个体化目标设定和积极的文化框架来增强他们的内源性依从性，并争取家庭支持。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术后老年患者居家康复锻炼决策的障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对中国 21 名全膝关节置换术后老年患者进行的定性研究，确定了居家康复锻炼决策的三个主题和十个亚主题，突出了冲动性回避反应（如疼痛、恐惧）为障碍，而理性坚持（如对预后不良的感知威胁、目标导向的意志力）为促进因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adherence to home-based rehabilitation after TKA in older adults is influenced by emotional and cognitive conflicts. When guiding these patients, you should focus not only on pain management but also enhance intrinsic adherence through individualized goal setting and positive cultural framing, while also securing family support.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量较小（21 名参与者），结果的普适性有限，且研究在中国进行，文化背景可能影响发现。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative study with a small sample size (21 participants), limiting generalizability, and conducted in China, where cultural context may influence findings.

items.title: Effect of Short-Rest Interval versus Traditional Multiple-Set Resistance Training Combined with Endurance Training in Patients with Cardiovascular Disease: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: This RCT (n=71) comparing short-rest interval (3/7 RT) and traditional multiple-set (3×9 RT) resistance training combined with endurance training in cardiac rehab patients found similar improvements in VO₂peak, 30-s sit-to-stand, and total lean mass. However, 3/7 RT resulted in greater improvements in quadriceps isokinetic strength (+23±20 N·m vs. +11±22 N·m; P=0.022).
items.curatedReason: 在心脏康复中，短休息间歇（3/7 RT）和传统多组（3x9 RT）抗阻训练在改善 VO₂peak、坐站能力和去脂体重方面效果相似。如果你的患者需要优先提升股四头肌等速力量，短休息间歇可能更有效，否则两种方法都可考虑。
items.titleZh: 短休息间歇与传统多组抗阻训练结合耐力训练对心血管疾病患者的影响：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机临床试验（n=71）比较了短休息间歇（3/7 RT）和传统多组（3×9 RT）抗阻训练与耐力训练相结合对心血管疾病患者心脏康复的影响。结果显示，两组在 VO₂peak、30 秒坐站测试和总去脂体重方面改善相似，但 3/7 RT 在股四头肌等速力量方面改善更显著（+23±20 N·m vs. +11±22 N·m；P=0.022）。
items.curatedReasonEn: In cardiac rehabilitation, short-rest interval (3/7 RT) and traditional multiple-set (3x9 RT) resistance training show similar efficacy in improving VO₂peak, sit-to-stand performance, and lean mass. If your patient prioritizes isokinetic quadriceps strength, short-rest might be more effective; otherwise, both modalities are viable.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对有限（71 名参与者），且随访期较短（12 周），长期效果和更广泛人群的适用性尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively limited sample size (71 participants) and a short follow-up period (12 weeks), so long-term effects and applicability to a broader population remain unclear.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Burden of fall-related injury and its predictors among stroke survivors attending comprehensive specialized hospitals in the Amhara Regional State, Ethiopia, 2024: A multicenter prospective study.
